cycles.method: Event: one 362.8 us audio frame's LFO-engine work, the module's only per-frame path (the frame builder's engine copy at 0x4000d032 runs 24 times a frame, one per audio track and LFO). Static: the stub's longest path is 96 executed instructions including es_lfo_route (longest path over the linked unit's control-flow graph, m68k-elf-objdump of out/platform/runtime/runtime.elf, scratch tool), so 24 x 96 = 2,304 instructions a frame. Measured: ot_emu instruction counter between the site and its resume address on the VACEUCLID8 image (0ed55659...1605384), all 8 audio tracks EUC on with all 24 LFOs on EUCLID destinations, playing in grid recording for 3 s (8,276 frames): every call 96, worst 24 consecutive calls 2,304. Cycles = instructions x 32, the per-instruction allowance Play Modes uses; chip cycles are not measured. Budget: one frame at 264 MHz. Not in this event: the sequencer's step path (another stack; up to 5,775 executed instructions a step measured for 8 modulated tracks, static bound not established because the stock slide search's iteration count is not bounded here) and UI-task events (knob, copy, project lines); see TESTING.md, Performance.

load.method: Not measured. cfmeter.py decodes the CF METER insert's readout from a capture of track 8; that insert (modules/cfmeter) is not in this repository and no hardware capture exists, so no stock or module interrupt and idle figures were taken. No model values substituted.
